headers.call_lift:
(W : StoredRecords.Weights) (t : ℚ) (r : Input)
    (rs : List Input) (acc : List StoredCandidates.Input)
    {k : ℕ} {s u : StoredCandidatePreparation.State}
    (ht : Trace (StoredCandidatePreparation.transition W t) k s u) :
    Trace (transition W t) k (.call r rs acc s) (.call r rs acc u)
headers.inputs_trace:
(W : StoredRecords.Weights) (t : ℚ) (rs : List Input)
    (acc : List StoredCandidates.Input) :
    Trace (transition W t) (scanSteps W rs) (.inputs rs acc)
      (.reverse ((result W t rs).reverse++acc) [])
headers.reverse_trace:
(W : StoredRecords.Weights) (t : ℚ) (rs out : List StoredCandidates.Input) :
    Trace (transition W t) (rs.length+1) (.reverse rs out) (.halt (rs.reverse++out))
headers.bank_trace:
(W : StoredRecords.Weights) (t : ℚ) (rs : List Input) :
    Trace (transition W t) (scanSteps W rs+rs.length+1) (.inputs rs []) (.halt (result W t rs))
headers.steps_le_input:
(W : StoredRecords.Weights) (rs : List Input) :
    scanSteps W rs+rs.length+1 ≤ inputBound rs
